drop_off_rule: Show items published within the last 7 days. Remove any item more than 14 days after its date_published, even if fewer than 10 items remain.

items.title: China's tech giants offer FDE pay approaching 1M yuan a year
items.summary: ByteDance, Tencent and Alibaba are recruiting forward-deployed engineers with annual packages approaching 1M yuan (about US$150K); Maimai data shows FDE postings in China up 1,523% in the first seven months of 2026 vs 2025.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: FDE demand is now global: Maimai ranks FDE as the fastest-growing AI technical role in China.

items.title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised on PyPI and Docker; upgrade from or pin 1.106.2 and rotate keys
items.summary: On Oct 21 LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised and pushed a malicious v1.107.0 that steals credentials. LiteLLM says the incident is contained.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Check every customer environment and CI image for LiteLLM 1.107.0; if found, remove it, pin 1.106.2 and rotate every cloud and model-provider key it could reach.

items.title: OpenAI's Patch the Planet coalition fixes critical PHP flaws found with GPT-5.6 Sol
items.summary: OpenAI led a two-month coordinated disclosure of critical vulnerabilities in PHP, found by Calif using GPT-5.6 Sol and independently by Wiz, and urges everyone running PHP to apply the maintainers' fixes now.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Check every customer stack that runs PHP and patch today; OpenAI also published a PHP version checker as a Codex skill to find vulnerable versions.

items.title: OpenAI models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden
items.summary: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex will be sold through Google Cloud Model Garden and Marketplace, count against GCP spend commitments, and later reach Google Antigravity and the Gemini Agent, with general availability planned in the coming weeks.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: GCP-committed customers will be able to use OpenAI models inside their existing governance and budget, which removes a common procurement blocker.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a proactive agent app, in research preview
items.summary: Claude Duet is a new Claude app built on Opus 5.5 that sends a morning brief, watches connected apps, takes on tasks in its own browser VM and asks for approval before big steps, starting by waitlist for US Pro and Max subscribers.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: It is a reference design for always-on business agents, with approval gates and a classifier for sensitive data that you can borrow for customer deployments.

items.title: US orders federal agencies to remove DeepSeek AI, including products built on it
items.summary: DHS ordered federal civilian agencies to stop buying DeepSeek products and services and remove them from government systems, and the order also covers third-party products built with DeepSeek technology, with exceptions by request.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: If you deploy for US federal customers, audit every stack for DeepSeek models or DeepSeek-based components now, including open weights hosted by third parties.

items.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, its production inference stack
items.summary: DeepSeek released DeepInfer under Apache-2.0, the vLLM-based inference framework it uses to serve DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at scale, though its most optimized KV cache and load balancing are not included.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: A production-proven reference for self-hosted inference that can cut serving costs for customers running open models, but check the new federal DeepSeek ban before proposing it to government customers.

items.title: Microsoft: treat deployed AI agents as insider threats
items.summary: Microsoft's official blog argues that frontier models, whatever their origin, can't be trusted, and that enterprises need guardian agents that watch and moderate every action of their own agents before it happens, extending its Project Perception security system to internal agents.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Enterprise security teams will now expect agent deployments to come with per-action monitoring, least-privilege tool access and audit trails, so build those into the design rather than bolting them on.

items.title: GitHub Copilot retired GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.7 Flash and Grok 4.5 on Oct 19
items.summary: GitHub deprecated six models across Copilot Chat, agent mode and completions on Oct 19, 2026, pointing users to GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.7 instead.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Customer workflows pinned to these models break now; Copilot Enterprise admins may need to enable the replacement models in their model policies.

items.title: IBM's ALTK-Evolve tops τ²-bench customer service with GPT-4.1 and learned memory
items.summary: IBM Research shows a stock ReAct agent on GPT-4.1, given guidelines learned from past runs, reaching 67.5% Pass^4 on τ²-bench retail, above every retail entry in its Oct 12 leaderboard snapshot, without changing model weights.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Learned playbooks can make cheaper models reliable on policy-bound support workflows, so try memory and guidelines before upgrading a customer to a pricier frontier model.

items.title: Vercel: running coding agent harnesses durably in the cloud
items.summary: Vercel's engineering blog explains how it runs long-lived agent harnesses like Claude Code and Pi in the cloud so sessions survive restarts and run for hours without a laptop staying awake.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Useful patterns for keeping customer-facing agents running around the clock with resumable sessions and persistent workspaces.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon is now generally available
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Argon, its new frontier model, to developers, enterprises and consumers. Introductory API price is $2/M input and $10/M output tokens, with cached input 95% off. Google says it ranks #1 on the Vals Index.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: A new frontier option at aggressive pricing, aimed at multi-step finance, legal and coding work. Expect customers to ask for bake-offs against their current model.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt open models for agents
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B multimodal model for always-on enterprise agents, plus Bolt 74B-A9B for local workstations now and Bolt E4B (4GB) on Oct 23.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Gives you an open agent model at server, workstation and edge sizes that customers can post-train on their data and run on their own NVIDIA hardware.

items.title: GitHub ships a REST API for Copilot model policies
items.summary: GET and PATCH endpoints for Copilot model policies are now generally available at the enterprise, enterprise team, enterprise app and organization levels.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Lets you script which models each customer org or team can use, instead of clicking through settings, which helps with rollouts and model deprecations.

items.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an open-weight frontier multimodal MoE
items.summary: Meta published Muse Spark Open on Hugging Face. It is an open-weight mixture-of-experts model that takes text, image, video and audio, with a 1M-token context window.
items.why_it_matters_for_FDEs: Gives FDEs a self-hostable multimodal frontier model for customers with data-residency or on-prem limits.
